audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers flag Fiora as the winner of all seven stages, including Level 1 — but the content whys say the opposite. whys[0] gives Garen the level-1 all-in, whys[2] calls it 'a coin-flip he can't dominate', whys[3] says 'it stays even', whys[5] says 'the window reads even'. The packet levelChart agrees with the prose: Garen / Skill x5 / Fiora.
audit.why: Garen's Decisive Strike (Q) is an 8s auto-reset that silences, so at level 1 Fiora cannot cast Riposte in response and he sticks with the move-speed burst. Through the mid levels Courage (W) blunts her E-crit Vital detonation, so neither side owns the stage. Only at two items does armour/HP stacking flip fully to her max-HP true damage.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Garen, Levels 2 through First item -> Skill, 2+ items -> Fiora. Chart flipped as one atomic group in both layers, plus phases[0].why rewritten so it stops promising free level-1 chip.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike text is good, but the phase whys refer to 'Courage's cooldown' without ever giving it, so the advice is untimed.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s and Judgment 9/8.25/7.5/6.75/6s; Decisive Strike is a flat 8s. Those numbers turn 'bait the W' into a real window.
audit.corrected: Put the 22s rank-1 Courage cooldown into the Levels 4-5 phase and the 24s Riposte cooldown into the corresponding don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Decisive Strike is an auto-attack reset, so the player has no tell to read.
audit.why: _missing/fiora.json flags autoreset-burst-tell: Garen's combo opens with a reset, and the wind-up — not the ability cast — is the cue to step back. It also flags Courage as a burst-absorbing shield, which the content layer already covers well in mid and wants.foe[1].
audit.corrected: Named the auto-reset wind-up as the step-back cue in the Level 2 phase why.

audit.why: The silence-blocks-Riposte interaction, the Courage damage-reduction window against the E crit, the Demacian Justice missing-HP true execute, and Perseverance regen as an anti-heal target are all already stated correctly and match the kit text. Riposte's stun upgrade needs a blocked immobilise; Garen has none, so it only ever returns a slow here — the page never wrongly claims otherwise.
The packet defect 'Demacian Justice's' in wants.foe[2] is a FALSE POSITIVE — it is the real ability name in possessive form. No change made.

edits.before: Q a vital and back out — free chip he cannot answer. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Decisive Strike silences you out of Riposte and the move-speed strike sticks — last-hit at range, never trade autos into a fresh Garen.

edits.before: W is your matchup answer; hold it for HIS key spell only. Only take the trade when Garen's Courage is down.
edits.after: Hold Riposte for his Judgment spin — the Decisive Strike auto-reset wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Courage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Courage is 22s at rank 1 — bait the damage reduction, then run the pattern in that gap. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.

edits.before: Garen wastes Courage — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Vitals deal max-HP true damage — his armour never reduces it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Burn it on poke and Riposte is gone for a full 24 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Perseverance regenerates a share of his max health out of combat — Grievous Wounds and pressure deny the reset.

notes: The content layer for this matchup is already close to the approved bar — spikes, early/mid/late and wants are accurate against the kit files, so most of the work was the level chart, which said Fiora x7 while its own explanations said Garen level 1 and even through mid. dontsFull[2] ('Let him reset with regen') carried Riposte text that belonged to a different don't; replaced with the actual Perseverance interaction. Packet defect on 'Demacian Justice's' is a false positive.
